section: 2 · single pin: YouTube search → results → shared link
coordinate_system: GLB +Y up, metres-ish, screens face +Z. Blender source +Z up, front -Y. Convert position (x,y,z) -> (x,z,-y). All numbers below are glTF space.
camera_note: The three cameras are also exported as glTF camera nodes with the same names (yfov radians, aspectRatio 1.6). Use position + target (lookAt) from this file; up = +Y. No depth of field in the live scene; the stills use a mild DOF.

PhoneScreen.uv: single quad, clean 0–1 UVs. glTF UV (0,0) = top-left of the image, (1,1) = bottom-right. Use texture.flipY = false.

TVScreen.uv: single quad, clean 0–1 UVs. glTF UV (0,0) = top-left of the image, (1,1) = bottom-right. Use texture.flipY = false.

screen_texture.material: unlit: replace the screen material with THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map, toneMapped:false }) as scene-runtime.js already does; preserve the full native frame, never crop
screen_texture.crossfade: 0.2 s emissive/opacity mix between the old and new map (two stacked MeshBasicMaterials or a mix uniform); time-based, triggered when progress crosses a swap point

tv-home.what: Illustrative TV home row, static lime focus ring on tile 1, no text, no logos.

tv-results.what: Illustrative YouTube results grid: search pill "lofi beats", YouTube logo, 3x2 palette tiles, lime focus ring on result 1.

tv-playing.what: Shared link playing: illustrative palette video frame + lime progress bar, small YouTube logo. No title, no times.

steps.copy: Type a YouTube search on your phone.
Send, and the results open on the TV.
Share a YouTube link from your phone. It plays on the TV.

camera_moves.ease: power2.inOut on local t; lerp position and target, lerp fov
power2.inOut on local t; lerp position and target, lerp fov

texture_swaps.why: results open only after Send; settled before the 0.5 snap
then the shared link plays on the TV; settled before the 0.9–1 hold

timeline.rule: No swap point lies inside a camera move. Reverse scroll crosses the same points backwards and shows the previous texture (crossfade 0.2 s).
timeline.why_not_step_midpoints: The spec's 'swap at step midpoint' (0.5 / 0.833) would fall at the 0.5 snap and inside the 'first 60%' camera move of the link step. These points keep every snapped state fully settled and every swap outside a move.

lighting.recommendation: RoomEnvironment via PMREMGenerator.fromScene (as runtime-contract.json), scene.environmentIntensity ≈ 0.45, one soft DirectionalLight from upper-left (-3,5,6) intensity ≈ 1.2. Keep toneMapping ACES or AgX with exposure ≈ 1. Screens and BiasStrip read as self-lit; the canvas background should be the section's --ink/#0b0e0d.
lighting.note: The stills are Cycles renders of the same scene with a wall, floor and a lime bias light; the live scene will be flatter. Verify poster-to-WebGL parity on the snapped states.

fallback.when: reduced motion · Save-Data · deviceMemory<4 · no WebGL2 · off-screen · innerWidth<900

materials: Brand tints only (#0b0e0d / #eeeee6 shades); BiasStrip is lime emissive (#d4fa7b). The YouTube logo appears only inside the TV textures.
claims: No cursor or pointer on either screen, no caret, no long press, generic names only (Living Room TV / Living room). The TV shows results only after Send (texture order enforces it).
